observation.visible_scene: A dark, low-light scene dominated by a bright white-blue light source at the left edge. A hand enters from the right, holding a small translucent square object (tile-like) in the center of the frame, lit by that source. The object glows brightly against the dark background, which shows faint texture on the right.
visible_changes: From frame 1 to about frame 32 the hand grips the square object between the thumb (lower-left of the object) and a finger (right side), continuously tilting and rotating it; the object's orientation shifts from a diagonal lean to a more face-on square and back, while its center stays in roughly the same central position.

The object's apparent color/brightness varies as it turns: early frames are blown-out white, while frames around 7, 13, 19, 24 show warm yellow tones at the edges, and from about frame 25 onward an internal diagonal/triangular pattern becomes visible through the translucent body as the viewing angle changes.

Around frame 33 the hand blurs and moves rightward, leaving the object; in frames 34-41 the square object stands alone in the center, still showing the internal pattern, with a small warm reflection at its base, and no fingers touching it.
The left light source and the dark background remain in place throughout; the framing shows only minor handheld jitter.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the object came to be held and what its true shape/pattern is is not shown before frame 1.
Whether the object was set down or was already resting upright when the hand withdrew is not visible.
What the hand does after exiting right (frames 34-41) is unknown.
uncertain_details: The bright left blob may be a direct light or its reflection on a surface; its exact nature is unclear.
The internal triangle seen late in the clip could be a feature of the object or an optical/refraction effect from rotation; not determinable.
Camera motion is uncertain (background evidence is sparse); only the hand/object relative motion is clearly supported.
